pr_comments: Just want to clarify things about fixing `FormHandlingTest`. Because of my change now we render the root component that contains `Router` component. When I tried to use a default layout in `Router` [FormsLayout](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Components/test/testassets/Components.TestServer/RazorComponents/Shared/FormsLayout.razor) there was an exception because `CascadingModelBinder` was used twice. Once in [RouteView](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/3b091f77be96f1c8555e6aa266ad4c4322af76c3/src/Components/Components/src/RouteView.cs#L79) and second in `FormsLayout`. So I just deleted `FormsLayout`. There are 2 tests that specifically don't use `CascadingModelBinder` so the components couldn't be rendered by the `Router`. For those 2 tests I created another 2 test classes with sturtups that call `MapRazorComponents<{App component with no Router and only the components that is tested}>`

> Just want to clarify things about fixing FormHandlingTest

What you've done sounds reasonable to me. If this is not what @javiercn expected then perhaps he can comment when he's back.

issue_context.title: Unified app model routing
issue_context.body:
- add `Router` component into `App.razor`
- make `MapRazorComponent` use `App.razor`
- change `MapRazorComponens` to always render the root component (`App.razor`)
- create `IRoutingStateProvider` to hold the `RouteData`
- use `IRoutingStateProvider` in `Router` to avoid routing twice

review_comments: Does this need to go through API review?
@javiercn , @SteveSandersonMS do you think we could include this to the final API review for Blazor United?

What do we think about the `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Endpoints.Builder` namespace? Do we expect much user code to reference it? If not, it's probably better than `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder` namespace `ComponentTypeMetadata` is currently in. But I don't think anything else exists in this namespace yet. What about [Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Endpoints](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.components.endpoints?view=aspnetcore-8.0)? I don't think this deserves its own namespace.

Stuff like the namespace can easily get missed if we try to cram everything in one big API review. Hopefully reviewing this will be fairly quick.

Who's going to use the `RootComponentMetadata`? It doesn't look like anything references it currently.

I see that the `rootComponent` `Type` now flows to `RazorComponentEndpointInvoker` via a lambda capture below. Does that mean `RootComponentMetadata` can be deleted?

If this is meant for public consumption or some future code we're going to write, we should at least write a test for now.
Root component metadata is for public consumption so that the endpoint can be identified.
We should definitely write a test for it then.
